subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) When they saw Mr. Monkey, they asked him to divide their bread into two equal halves. (b) Then Mr. Monkey broke the bread into two pieces and put them on his scales. (c) Mr. Monkey was so wise and just that the other rat agreed to take their problem to him. (d) Once two rats found a piece of bread. (e) "Let's go and see our friend, Mr. Monkey and ask for his advise." (f) They couldn't agree on how to divide it, because each rat wanted a larger piece than the other. (g) Then one of the rats said, "We've argued and fought for so long that now we're tired." (h) "Well, that's not easy," said Monkey. "So, it'll cost you a lot." R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Reordering sentences (d) + (f) + (g) + (e) + (c) + (a) + (b) + (h) Section B : Writing Test
